scoring_method: Each dimension is scored from 0 to 100 and multiplied by its weight. Only reproducible local evidence, code/test evidence, or explicitly documented evidence receives credit. The score is not a production SLA, capacity result, or security certification.

dimensions.name: requirements_and_core_functionality
dimensions.evidence: Stages 0-19 cover authentication, organization, projects/tasks, comments, attachments, reminders, notifications, audit, frontend and deployment paths; stage 8 acceptance Compose and smoke are repeatable, while Playwright ran 6/9 with 3 real browser/notification failures, so full browser coverage remains incomplete.

dimensions.name: architecture_and_explainability
dimensions.evidence: The modular monolith has explicit MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ and MinIO boundaries, state-machine validation, optimistic concurrency, idempotency and compensation paths; the topology is still local-learning oriented.

dimensions.name: security_and_data_protection
dimensions.evidence: Stage 9 added HttpOnly TASKFLOW_ACCESS Cookie, CSRF token/header protection, prod Secure validation, logout cookie clearing, Redis session revocation and same-origin WebSocket Cookie authentication. Formal React no longer reads or writes JWT localStorage. Bearer compatibility, external Secret Manager/rotation, real Ingress proxy isolation and production certificate management remain gaps; npm has 2 moderate advisories and OWASP failed on network/high-risk dependency findings.

dimensions.name: tests_builds_and_regression
dimensions.evidence: Stage 9 default Maven regression completed 75/0/1, targeted Cookie/CSRF tests completed 10/0/0, explicit Testcontainers verify completed 75/0/0, frontend typecheck/build and acceptance smoke passed. The latest Playwright run passed login/401/403/task write 4 scenarios, failed duplicate-submit assertion, and did not complete later notification scenarios; full browser E2E remains incomplete.

dimensions.name: evaluation_and_observability
dimensions.evidence: A fixed local performance baseline, protected runtime metrics, EXPLAIN output, Actuator metrics, JaCoCo XML/HTML, official npm audit and a final six-scenario fault artifact exist. Stage 8 acceptance smoke and small performance data preparation passed with injected credentials; the full same-parameter replay remains unexecuted, final fault snapshots lack DB facts/authenticated probes, and OWASP failed with dependency findings.

dimensions.name: runtime_integration_and_recovery_readiness
dimensions.evidence: Six Compose services were healthy, exact container restart recovered health, Redis/RabbitMQ/MinIO/MySQL/backend stop/start scenarios executed, and Kind overlay rollout plus backend Pod recovery passed. Final fault snapshots had no DB fact counts and no authenticated probe; RabbitMQ was unavailable in part of the post-restart snapshot. Stage 6 WSS 101 remains prior local evidence, while no Ingress Controller, STOMP/browser notification recovery, HPA or multi-node HA evidence exists.

dimensions.name: engineering_governance
dimensions.evidence: Two readable GitHub Actions workflows separate fast checks from Testcontainers/coverage/security jobs; the remote integration-security run exposed exit code 126 from mvnw mode 100644, now fixed with executable mode and bash invocation. A post-fix remote rerun and actionlint are still missing.

dimensions.name: documentation_and_delivery_credibility
dimensions.evidence: README, CHANGELOG, stage documents, final optimization summary, Chinese interview material and the acceptance report were synchronized with the final evidence and explicit production boundaries.
